programme.title: New: Prison Chronicles

programme.title: New: Prison Chronicles
programme.desc: The Soviet Gulag: In its first 40 years, the Soviet Gulag system imprisoned 18 million and killed over 1.5 million. Discover three tales of survival. (S1, ep 12)

programme.title: My Strange Arrest
programme.desc: Mr. Funks Wild Ride: A man calls 911 on the cops, plus allegations are made against a woman accused of stealing a horse and buggy. (S2, ep 19)

programme.title: My Strange Arrest
programme.desc: Sweet Tea Pleasure: The accused, arresting officers and witnesses share their insights on some of the strangest and wildest crimes, revealing the real-life consequences. (S2, ep 20)

programme.title: Alien Files: Unsealed
programme.desc: Series investigating compelling UFO and alien cases by opening previously off-limits secret files. Does the mysterious Blue Planet Project hold the answers? (S1, ep 1)

programme.desc: Zatoon Bibi's secret affair with Tanveer Iqbal in Birmingham spiralled into obsession after he ended their relationship. (S5, ep 6)

programme.title: Storage Wars Texas
programme.desc: When Vic Comes To Shove: Some of the buyers reveal their bad sides as an unexpected fight breaks out among bidders in Henderson. (S6, ep 12)

programme.title: Storage Wars Texas

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Burmese or Busted?: Les gets excited over a jar of powdered gold. He believes it's worth thousands. But is it valuable or just eyeshadow? An explosive acid test reveals all. (S7, ep 9)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Lawyer Up Son: The shop lands itself in trouble when a customer calls in their lawyer to settle a huge row over a fake receipt. Fortunately, Les has a trick up his sleeve. (S7, ep 10)

programme.desc: Scotland v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Jill Douglas presents all the action from the match at Scottish Gas Murrayfield. Scotland impressed in the Southern Hemisphere Series, winning two of their three matches, but they face a tough test against the All Blacks, who have won all of their contests in the competition so far. With analysis from John Barclay, Greig Laidlaw and Sean Fitzpatrick, commentary by Miles Harrison and Johnnie Beattie, and reports from Gabriel Clarke

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Wales v Japan (Kick-off 4.40pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the match at Principality Stadium. Both teams won just one match of three in the Southern Hemisphere series and will be looking to impress this evening. The last time the nations met was in Wales' 2025 tour of Japan, when the teams won one match apiece. With analysis from Dan Biggar and Sam Warburton, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams and Jamie Roberts

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: France v Fiji (Kick-off 8.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the match at Groupama Stadium in Lyon. This is the first game of the Northern Hemisphere series for both teams, and France narrowly lost to New Zealand in their first contest of the Southern Series, before recording victories over Australia and Japan. They will expect to continue their winning run against the Fijians, who have lost all three of their matches so far against Wales, England and Scotland. With analysis from Dan Biggar and Jamie Roberts, and commentary by Johnnie Hammond and Ben Kayser

programme.title: Battle Of The Irish Dancers
programme.desc: One Step Forward, Two Steps Back: Dancers and their teachers, we shine a light on this amazing art form, which requires the strength, endurance and agility of an Olympian. (2 of 3)

programme.title: Science Fiction In The Atomic Age
programme.desc: Mary Shelley to Isaac Asimov: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein is often seen as the first sci-fi work, joined by early pieces from More, Swift, Wells and Huxley. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Douglas Adams: The Man Who Imagined Our Future
programme.desc: Douglas Adams was a visionary in sci-fi, comedy and activism, campaigning for endangered species and climate change long before his time.

programme.title: Inside Art: Van Gogh At The Courtauld Gallery
programme.desc: Kate Bryan pays a visit to the Courtauld Gallery to bear witness to an exhibition bringing the full span of Vincent van Gogh's self-portraiture together.

programme.title: New: Portrait Artist Of The Year 2026
programme.desc: New. The artists paint broadcaster Rylan Clark, musician Alison Balsom or theatre director Jamie Lloyd. Who will advance? (S13, ep 5)

programme.title: Wordsworth & Coleridge...
programme.desc: ...Road Trip with Frank Skinner and Denise Mina. The pair embark on a new journey, hoping to learn more about literary greats William Wordsworth and Samuel Taylor Coleridge. (2 of 3)

programme.title: Stories From Tate Britain
programme.desc: Focusing on the art and artists within Tate Britain's collection, featuring various art historians and cultural figures exploring different themes and artists. (1 of 2)

programme.title: The Sixties
programme.desc: The Space Race: A look at the beginning of space exploration and the competition between the United States and the Soviet Union to be the first to land on the moon. (S1, ep 7)

programme.title: LSO: Rattle Conducts Sibelius & Bruckner
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts Sibelius' tone poems and Bruckner's radiant Seventh Symphony, where vast landscapes merge with the human soul.

programme.title: The Joy Of Painting
programme.desc: Ocean Breeze: Bob shifts to a vertical canvas to create a scene with fluffy clouds, overlooking a seascape of crashing waves and churning foam on a shore of jagged rocks. (S10, ep 5)

programme.title: The Joy Of Painting
programme.desc: Autumn Woods: Bob creates a vertical explosion of colour with blazing orange, gold trees and a ridge of magnificent mountain peaks. (S10, ep 6)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Mr Botibol's First Love: Jake Weston stars in this twisted story. A jaded businessman sells his company and attempts to change his life for the better by buying a strange piano. (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: The Umbrella Man: John Mills stars in this story with a twist. A con man arrives in town and starts his scam. Michael Gambon guest stars. (S2, ep 9)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: The Return of the Hero: Sergeant Andre is a returning veteran heading home with his friend Marcel - the man who will bail him out of his pre-marital problem. (S3, ep 22)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: The Right Kind of House: Mr Waterbury believes he can get a good deal on some real estate due to the home's dark past, but he hasn't dealt with the owner Sadie Grimes. (S3, ep 23)

programme.title: Discovering: Whoopi Goldberg
programme.desc: A look into the life and career of one of Hollywood's most recognisable stars, known for her work in The Colour Purple, Sister Act, Glory and more. (S12, ep 3)

programme.title: Discovering: David Bowie
programme.desc: Leading music critics and DJs discuss the life, music, legacy and larger-than-life stage characters of the glam rock legend.

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: The Flypaper: Lorna Charles and Alfred Burke star in this twisted tale. With a 12 year-old found dead and a killer perhaps on the loose, a young girl becomes paranoid. (S2, ep 10)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: The Orderly World of Mr Appleby: Robert Lang stars in this tale with a twist. A man married three times might be lucky for the fourth time when he meets a new interest. (S2, ep 11)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: The Foghorn: Lucia meets and falls for Allen Bliss at a party that is a celebration of her engagement to another man, John St. Rogers. To her dismay, Allen himself is married. (S3, ep 24)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: Flight to the East: A newsman taking a trip to Egypt describes his past connection with arms trafficking to a fellow passenger who knows part of his story is untrue. (S3, ep 25)

programme.title: The Sixties
programme.desc: 1968: A look at the year which saw the assassinations of Robert F Kennedy and Martin Luther King Jr, as well as the escalation of the Vietnam War and civil rights protests. (S1, ep 8)

programme.title: Discovering: Jodie Foster
programme.desc: From a child model to an Academy Award nominated performance in Taxi Driver, this is the story of Jodie Foster's life and breakthrough to Hollywood. (S13, ep 4)

programme.title: Landscape Artist Of The Year
programme.desc: Joan Bakewell and Frank Skinner welcome a new group of artists to Knaresborough, where they are challenged to paint the striking views of the historic viaduct. (4 of 9)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Fat Chance: A pharmacist tries to elope with his lover, but his larger than life wife stands in his way. John Castle and Miriam Margolyes star in this tale with a twist. (S2, ep 12)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Back For Christmas: A philandering physician with an obsession for orchids cultivates a deadly plot to see off his wife. Siân Phillips and Richard Johnson star. (S3, ep 1)

programme.title: The Alfred Hitchcock Hour
programme.desc: A Tangled Web: A charming French maid elopes with a professional burglar, but his jealous accomplice has his own plans. (S1, ep 18)

programme.title: New: Portrait Artist Of The Year 2026
programme.desc: New. The artists paint broadcaster Rylan Clark, musician Alison Balsom or theatre director Jamie Lloyd. Who will advance? (S13, ep 5)

programme.title: Matisse: The Last Masterpiece
programme.desc: Matisse: The Last Masterpiece: An unlikely wartime bond inspires Henri Matisse to create his bold masterpiece, the Chapelle du Rosaire, where art and faith collide. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Classic Movies: Dead Of Night
programme.desc: Ian Nathan explores what makes a classic, going behind the scenes of iconic films to reveal the ingredients of cinematic greatness. (S6, ep 3)

programme.title: The Fog
programme.desc: An unearthly fog rolls into a small coastal town, exactly 100 years after a ship mysteriously sank in its waters. Supernatural horror starring Jamie Lee Curtis and Adrienne Barbeau. (1980)

programme.title: Discovering: Janet Leigh
programme.desc: A fascinating portrait of Janet Leigh, the American actress, singer, dancer and author who is best remembered for her Golden Globe-winning performance in Psycho. (S6, ep 11)

programme.title: New: Classic Movies: The Elephant Man

programme.desc: Price of Vanity. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Christopher Lee & Eric Lander. A young artist has the key to a successful career, he can fake old masters well enough to deceive an art critic.

programme.title: The Detectives
programme.desc: House Call. Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West.

programme.title: Hollow Triumph
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directed by Steve Sekely. Stars Paul Henreid, Joan Bennett, Leslie Brooks & Eduard Franz. Pursued by the gambler he robbed, John Muller takes on a new identity, with ironic results.

programme.title: The Delavine Affair
programme.desc: 1955. Crime drama starring Peter Reynolds, Honor Blackman and Gordon Jackson. The death of a local man leads a local reporter to seek his killer.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: With All My Heart
programme.desc: 1955. Stars Ida Lupino, Walter Coy & Noreen Nash. A schoolteacher's miserable love life improves after a childhood sweetheart brings out her inner beauty.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Ritual. 1975. Stars Douglas Fielding, Susan Jameson, John Nettleton. Skinner has been shot dead, and the Murder Squad have taken over the case. So why is Haggar meeting a mate halfway down the M6?

programme.title: And The Same To You
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy starring Sid James, Brian Rix, Leo Franklyn, Tommy Cooper and Vera Day. The boxing-mad nephew of a pious clergyman embarks on an elaborate plan to keep his boxing career a secret.

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: A year and a Day. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Iain Gregory & Derrick Sherwin. A desperate man steals Richard's horse and the squire of Fitzgeorge castle takes him in.

programme.title: Sleeping Car To Trieste
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Director: John Paddy Carstairs. Stars Jean Kent, Bonar Colleano, Albert Lieven & David Tomlinson. Agents break into an embassy in Paris to steal a diary filled with political secrets.

programme.title: Dangerous Cargo
programme.desc: 1954. Drama directed by John Harlow. Tim (Jack Watling) is tricked by a wartime friend (Terence Alexander) into revealing details of a gold shipment.

programme.title: Brighton Rock
programme.desc: 1947. Crime. Directed by John Boulting. Stars Richard Attenborough & Hermione Baddeley. Small time gang leader, Pinkie Brown, desperately tries to cover his tracks after he murders a journalist.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1965. Personal and Confidential. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Ellen McIntosh. Police investigating a suspicious death find a file marked 'Top Secret' in the victim's briefcase. (S1, E07)

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: This week, enjoy a reel on leaving school and finding a job in 1950s Yorkshire! Jean Muir is here to persuade you to part with your shillings, Tufty has some sound advice and visit 1950s Slough!

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Maigret and the Liberty Bar. 1997. Stars Bruno Cremer, Pascale Roberts & Marina Golovine. Maigret is sent to Antibes to investigate the murder of an Australian who'd been with French intelligence.

programme.title: Bullshot
programme.desc: 1983. Comedy. Directed by Dick Clement. Stars Alan Shearman, Diz White & Ronald E. House. Dashing Captain, Hugh 'Bullshot' Crummond, must put his talents to the test and save the world.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1960. Evidence in Concrete. Directed by Gordon Hales. Starring Russell Napier, Howard Pays and Peter Welch. A young girl's body found near a busy motorway tells of something sinister. (S1, E34)

programme.title: Murders In...
programme.desc: Murders in Avignon - Meurtres à Avignon. 2015. Director: Stéphane Kappes. Stars Catherine Jacob & Laëtitia Milot. Police investigate a skeleton found in a secret chamber in the Palais des Papes.

programme.title: The Lawless Years
programme.desc: The Marie Walters Story. 1959. Stars James Gregory, Robert Karnes & Barbara Stuart. Detective Ruditsky solves the murder of a young woman by uncovering crucial evidence.

programme.title: The First Travelling Saleslady
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy Western. A corset store owner goes broke and becomes a traveling sales lady in Texas 1897. Starring Ginger Rogers, Barry Nelson and a young Clint Eastwood.

programme.title: A Celebration of Nettlefold Studios and Cecil Hepworth
programme.desc: Join Dr Simon Brown, Mike Read, William Russell and Patricia Dainton to celebrate the famous Nettlefold Studios. We explore the history of Nettlefold.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Hot Off the Griddle. 1966. Stars Adam West & Julie Newmar. The thefts of a department store catalogue, a catamaran, and three mittens, alerts Batman and Robin that Catwoman is loose again.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Cat and the Fiddle. 1966. Stars Adam West, Julie Newmar & Jack Kelly. Batman and Robin discover Catwoman is now masquerading as rich old Minerva Matthews and must stop her next scheme.

programme.title: A Taste Of Money
programme.desc: 1960. Comedy. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Jean Cadell, Dick Emery and Pete Murray. An elderly spinster plots to rob her employers with the perfect crime!

programme.title: House of Blackmail
programme.desc: 1953. Crime. Directed by Maurice Elvey. An Army officer (William Sylvester) and Carol (Mary Germaine) must solve the murder of a blackmailer or be charged themselves.

programme.title: Susan Lenox: Her Rise and Fall
programme.desc: 1931. Drama. Directed by Robert Z. Leonard. Stars Greta Garbo & Clark Gable. A young girl who escapes from home to find a new life, falls in love with a kind stranger, but fate keeps them apart.

programme.title: Mad Mel and Mister Gibson
programme.desc: 2021. The rise, fall and resurrection of Mel Gibson, one of the most successful but also controversial Hollywood stars. From Mad Max to The Passion of the Christ, from Lethal Weapon to Braveheart.

programme.title: Stranger In Town
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed George Pollock. Starring Alex Nicol, Anne Paige & Mary Laura Wood. In a sleepy village, a composer is shot dead and a woman is found gassed. Who killed them and why?

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Master Spy. 1959. Stars Conrad Phillips, Adrienne Corri & Jack Watling. A beautiful but dangerous spy, known as The Shadow, is sent by Gessler to lure Tell and his followers into a trap.

programme.title: The Love Match
programme.desc: Comedy. Director: David Paltenghi. Stars Arthur Askey, Glenn Melvyn & Thora Hird. Two football loving railway workers get into trouble after racing their engine home to get to a match on time.

programme.title: The Sea Shall Not Have Them
programme.desc: 1954. War. Directed by Lewis Gilbert. Stars Michael Redgrave, Dirk Bogarde & Bonar Colleano. In 1944, passengers of a downed aircraft discuss their lives while awaiting rescue from the North Sea.

programme.title: Mr Denning Drives North
programme.desc: 1951. Crime. Director: Anthony Kimmins. Stars John Mills, Phyllis Calvert & Eileen Moore. A British aircraft engineer accidentally kills his daughter's boyfriend and then tries to it cover up...

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Deadly Goddess Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Michael Strong. Solo faces death and Illya faces possible matrimony as they try to steal significant funds from THRUSH.

programme.title: Tales of Manhattan
programme.desc: 1942. Drama. Director: Julien Duvivier. Stars Charles Boyer, Rita Hayworth, Henry Fonda. An anthology of five stories revolving around a cursed tailcoat that brings misfortune to all who wear it.

programme.title: So Evil, So Young
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars Jill Ireland, Ellen Pollock & John Charlesworth. Framed for robbery and sent to a reform school, a young girl becomes the target of a vicious warden.

programme.title: The Rough and the Smooth
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Starring Nadja Tiller, Tony Britton and William Bendix. Directed by Robert Siodmak. An archaeologist forsakes his fiancée for a passionate affair with a beautiful German woman.
